About
I'm an ITSA student building toward a career in cybersecurity, with a solid foundation in networking, systems administration, and IT support. I'm comfortable troubleshooting hardware and operating systems, configuring TCP/IP networks, and applying core security concepts like firewalls, VPNs, and subnetting — and I'm sharpening those skills through coursework and hands-on labs.
I'm looking for an entry-level Help Desk, IT Support, or SOC Analyst role on a team where I can keep learning from experienced security professionals.
	
🎯 Target roles	Help Desk / IT Support · SOC Analyst (Entry-Level) · IT Security Support
🤝 Looking for	A team environment with mentorship from senior security staff
📍 Status	Completing ITSA coursework, open to entry-level opportunities now
